chapters.title: Dashboards|as code
narration: These are the dashboards of file_host, the server behind my apps. They're jsonnet and libsonnet in its repository, built in CI by the image my home server runs, so every panel is in the commit history.
The numbers are sample data: a GitHub job loads a made-up week into a throwaway Prometheus and photographs these panels. My server's real numbers stay at home.

chapters.title: Why these|panels
narration: I picked the panels that say whether it stays up and how it says no: restarts, the services it needs, and what the rate limiter turns away.
They lean towards staying up and refusing well, not towards speed yet. When that changes, new dashboards are one pull request away.
